items.description: Frontline near Russian-occupied city in southern Ukraine quiet for first time in years ahead of planned evacuationA local ceasefire in a southern Ukrainian city under Russian occupation appeared to be holding on Tuesday, with both sides ceasing drone attacks ahead of an apparent evacuation of about 2,000 trapped and de…

items.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attacks on Saudi oil refinery and defense ministry
items.description: Earlier on Tuesday, a Houthi official said the Egyptian parliament's decision to authorize defensive military support for Saudi Arabia amounted to a declaration of war.

items.title: 'Get Killed Or Starve': Life Under Russian Occupation In Oleshky
items.description: Residents fleeing Russian-occupied Oleshky describe hunger, soaring food prices, and threats from Russian soldiers. Cut off from supplies, civilians risk mines and drone attacks to escape. Now, a proposed cease-fire could open a humanitarian corridor for those still trapped in the Ukrainian city.

items.title: Truce begins in Ukraine city where residents ate weeds to survive
items.description: The Oleshky ceasefire, which the White House said was secured by US First Lady Melania Trump, is meant to allow aid to get in and civilians to get out.

items.title: Sudan’s war steals children’s future with school closures and displacement
items.description: The conflict in Sudan has left millions of children without education, as they work to help their families.

items.title: Kiev, 'la tregua a Oleshky durerà fino alle 23 di domenica'
items.description: "Ogni sforzo di de-escalation di questo tipo avvicina la pace tanto attesa in Ucraina"

items.title: Localised Russia-Ukraine ceasefire starts in Ukrainian town facing starvation
items.description: A localised ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia took effect early Tuesday (October 27) ahead of a humanitarian mission led by US first lady Melania Trump, as missile attacks resumed in Kyiv. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Kyiv, Emmanuelle Chaze, has more.

items.title: Israelis abroad flock home for ‘most important election we’ve ever had’
items.description: Democracy. The Hamas attack. Wars in Gaza, Lebanon, and Iran. Netanyahu’s long tenure. For Israelis returning home to vote, the list of momentous issues is long.

items.title: Local ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump starts in southern Ukraine
items.description: A localized ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia took effect early Tuesday ahead of a humanitarian mission brokered by U.S. first lady Melania Trump, as missile attacks resumed in Kyiv.

items.title: Why Ukraine may be involved in Mali's conflict
items.description: Allegations that Ukrainian specialists are supporting Tuareg rebels in Mali highlight Kyiv's effort to challenge Russian influence far beyond the battlefield in Europe.

items.title: ‘Still Just a Child’: The Russian Teenagers Fighting and Dying in Ukraine
items.description: A growing number of Russian soldiers who were still schoolchildren when the full-scale invasion of Ukraine began are being killed in the war.

items.title: Ukraine: Investigators find Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians
items.description: Top human rights experts investigating Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine said on Monday that the Russian authorities had committed war crimes and crimes against humanity by attacking civilians and vital energy infrastructure, among other violations of international law.

items.title: Russia Says Ukraine Peace Talks Won’t Slow War, Open to Local Truces
items.description: Russia says upcoming US-brokered peace talks will not slow its war against Ukraine but signals openness to local humanitarian truces. The Kremlin’s stance comes as a ceasefire is planned for Russian-occupied Oleshky to allow aid deliveries and civilian evacuations.
